Dear Marvin Hoffmann,
Thank you for your positive review. It's a great encouragement to all of our staff.
We look forward to your continued support.

They were very kind and helpful when I had sudden diarrhea.

They also provided IV treatment at my home when I became unable to move.

Everyone at this hospital is very kind and easy to talk to.

Our beloved dog, who suffers from severe hydrocephalus, has been receiving care at this clinic for about a year and a half.

We were told our dog might not live past one year old, but thanks to the dedicated support of the doctors, he will soon be turning four.

He has faced numerous life-threatening seizures and illnesses, and each time we were overwhelmed with anxiety. However, the doctors always explained everything carefully and supported our family throughout the treatment process.

This surgery was also high-risk, and we were very worried, but the thorough preparation and post-operative care allowed us to entrust our dog to them with complete peace of mind. We are truly grateful.

Furthermore, compared to our previous hospital, the medication costs are reasonable, and we greatly appreciate the careful consultation regarding necessary treatments.

We have three dachshunds, including a rescue dog, and the reception staff, nurses, and veterinarians are all incredibly kind and always show great affection to our dogs.


Beyond their excellent diagnostic skills and knowledge, this hospital truly conveys a deep sense of care and concern for these children.

Now, our entire family can entrust our pets to them with complete peace of mind; it's an indispensable hospital for our family.

Thank you so much for repeatedly saving our child's life. We look forward to your continued support.

They provided a more detailed and thorough explanation than any other animal hospital I've ever been to.

Also, they actively incorporate the latest medical advancements, so I feel reassured knowing that their treatments are always up-to-date.

Dr. Suzuki and the hospital are very trustworthy.

My elderly dog, who has a chronic illness, was in critical condition due to an acute illness, but thanks to the very dedicated treatment, he has recovered. I don't know what the future holds, but I'm grateful that they gave me time to prepare for the sudden loss of my pet. It's naturally expensive given the location, but it's not expensive compared to other clinics. I think I'll continue to use their services in the future. Also, there's a coin parking lot next door, so although it's not always possible to find a spot, it's generally very convenient.

A female veterinarian who couldn't even implant a microchip
She administered the vaccine right in front of me, but when it came to implanting a microchip, she made me wait at the reception desk, took the cat out of sight, and said, "After observing her, I couldn't implant the microchip. I recommend doing it when you can sedate her." However, my cat isn't afraid of the vet and even jumps onto the vet, so she shouldn't have been too scared.

The vet simply lacked the skill to implant a microchip. If she couldn't do it, she should have refused from the start. It was a waste of the cat's energy and a waste of the owner's waiting time. They should also state on their website that they don't offer microchip services.

Dear River,
Thank you for your positive review. It encourages all of our staff.
We look forward to your continued support.
I rely on them because they have a wide range of medical departments.

I lost trust due to testing without prior explanation or consent.

I had been going to this hospital for over two years because it was close to my home and easy to get to. I hadn't had any major issues up until then.

However, an incident last December caused me to completely lose trust in the hospital.

That day, I left my beloved Pomeranian at the hospital solely for grooming.

I hadn't made an appointment with the veterinarian, nor had I given consent for the test or examination.

After the grooming session, I was told that the veterinarian had some comments to make. When I went to pick him up, I found that an examination and X-ray had been performed without my prior explanation or consent, and I was charged for these.

I felt extremely anxious and scared that medical procedures had been performed on my dog ​​while it was being groomed without its owner's knowledge.

I had been aware of the diagnosis (tracheal collapse) for some time, and had been told by several veterinarians both in Japan and abroad that follow-up observation, focusing on lifestyle management, would be sufficient. For this reason, I had refused the X-ray.

Despite this, tests were performed and medication was initiated. A few days after starting treatment, my dog's cough worsened and he began to have trouble sleeping. The symptoms subsided when the medication was discontinued.

As a result of this series of events, I feel I cannot leave my dog ​​at this hospital again.

Also, with another dog, I was previously advised that surgery was a possibility, and we took him to a specialist, but it turned out that surgery was not actually necessary. This experience was another reason why I lost trust in the hospital.

I believe that tests and treatments should always be fully explained in advance, and only be carried out with the owner's consent.
Unfortunately, in my experience, this was not the case.

My dog ​​has been under the care of Dr. Suzuki, the hospital director, for many years, even before the clinic opened. Dr. Suzuki is always thorough and explains things clearly so that patients without medical knowledge can understand. He also sincerely addresses even the smallest questions, so I am grateful that I can properly understand my dog's illness, feel at ease each time, and entrust him with treatment. In addition, the other staff members and receptionists are also very kind and always treat us with courtesy, making it a wonderful hospital. I am truly grateful that my dog ​​was able to overcome a severe heart disease and is still healthy in his old age, thanks to Dr. Suzuki's accurate treatment and the coordinated support of all the staff. We look forward to continuing to rely on your services in the future.

We have been using your services since the clinic opened.

My rambunctious dog and overprotective owner both adore the doctors and everyone here.

I'm an overprotective owner and I ask a lot of questions, but you always explain everything so carefully.

Your grooming skills are excellent, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in your care.

Even though injections and blood tests are unpleasant procedures, my dog ​​goes in willingly, which makes me think that you're lovingly caring for him even when I'm not watching.

November 2025 Update:

Dr. Suzuki, Dr. Sato, Dr. Kobayashi, Dr. Yagi, Dr. Masuda, and all the staff, thank you as always. My dog ​​still loves you all. We are always greeted kindly at the reception, and my dog ​​is always delighted. During examinations, you thoroughly explain everything to answer the owner's questions, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in your care. Your grooming skills are excellent, and I always feel confident leaving my dog ​​in your care. You always make him look adorable. I'm so grateful to all of you for always taking such good care of your dogs. Thanks to you, my dog ​​is in good health!

I think all the doctors are good, but the receptionists always seem like they're just part-timers, which is disappointing. It's like the service at a casual pub; it spoils the hospital's image and lowers its overall standard.

Hospitals with good reputations usually have professional receptionists. They should at least receive basic etiquette training.

My dog ​​was already feeling unwell, and my regular hospital was closed, so I came here for treatment.
I was prescribed some medication, with instructions to stop using it if any side effects occurred, but his condition worsened within a day and he passed away on the second day.
That may have been the end of his life, but it's clear that the prescribed medication was the cause, and I was so shocked that I couldn't cope, so I decided to write this.
I hope that no other pet owners have to go through a similar experience.

We always have Dr. Suzuki examine our child!

I was referred to him for a second opinion when my child was in critical condition, and he is a very passionate doctor who has saved our child's life many times!

I am so grateful for the kind words he gave us at the very end.
Thank you so much.
We look forward to your continued support.
To anyone who has gone to another hospital, please don't give up and try going here.
His assessment is completely different.
I'm so glad I didn't give up.

Thank you for your post.

We look forward to your continued support.

Dear Yui Serizawa,
Thank you for your positive review. It's a great encouragement to all of our staff.
We look forward to your continued support.

I've been going to this veterinary clinic since it opened several years ago.
Initially, I was seen by the head veterinarian, but I had doubts about his explanations. When I questioned him about it, his attitude suddenly changed, and a part-time veterinarian started seeing my dog.
One time, an antifungal medication meant for itchy ears was applied to a wound in my dog, and I was instructed to apply it daily. However, when I got a second opinion at another hospital, I was told that the medication should absolutely never be applied to a wound. This is a dangerous animal hospital.

Dear m ka,
Thank you so much for your positive review. It's a great encouragement to all of our staff.
We look forward to your continued patronage.

We have five cats, but each one is treated with care and attention.

One of our cats had a life-threatening illness, but it was detected early, and now she's very healthy.

All the staff are cheerful and kind, and I'm so glad we found such a good hospital.

The head veterinarian was incredibly arrogant. My child had been a patient there for a long time, and when he said my child only had a week left, he said things like, "If my child survives longer than that, then my prediction was wrong and they didn't die." I had been going there for years, and it was a continuous string of unpleasant experiences. When my child's condition worsened, I called and asked if I could come in now, but he hung up saying there was nothing to do and I didn't need to come. I will never go there again, and I will never forget or forgive those veterinarians and nurses who have no understanding of animal feelings.

I've been under the care of the head veterinarian for a long time, ever since my previous hospital visits. My senior dog has heart disease, but thanks to the precise treatment, he's doing well. The doctor and all the staff are very kind, and I rely on them a lot.

I am truly overwhelmed with gratitude to this hospital 😢
I recently got a puppy, and he had a cough from the day he came home, so I was looking for a hospital I could go to immediately.
It was a Sunday, and I called various hospitals, but there were no openings...
However, unlike the others, this hospital, even though there were no openings, was able to see my puppy after the last dog with an appointment left (TT)
Thank you so much.

Not only the doctor, but also the nurses and reception staff are kind and polite, making it a hospital I can visit with peace of mind.

I am always grateful for the care I receive from the head doctor. He always examines me with care and attention, and I feel at ease entrusting my care to him. Thank you to all the staff for your kind and friendly service.

Dr. Suzuki, the clinic director, is truly wonderful.

All the staff are also incredibly kind and friendly.

I started going to this veterinary clinic because it's close to my home, and the staff, including the head veterinarian, receptionists, and nurses, are always very polite and helpful.
The head veterinarian, in particular, listens attentively to any concerns and considers various approaches. The fees seem a little cheaper than the nearby Shirokane Takanawa Animal Hospital. I suppose it's understandable that the fees are higher due to the location. When my dog ​​needed treatment for its leg, they wrote a referral letter to a very well-known orthopedic clinic, and I later learned that they were affiliated with that clinic. A friend who works in the insurance industry told me that a veterinarian who recommends such a clinic from the start is very trustworthy. As mentioned in other reviews, there's a possibility of misdiagnosis (which shouldn't happen) since it involves animals. However, my dog ​​has been helped many times, and they've always treated him very well, so I would like to continue going there.
